title: Ops Navigator — weekly sync agenda + action tracker
body:
Purpose: quick cross-team sync focused on short blockers for the serving runtime + console handoffs. Keep to 45m. Main goals: unblock deployments, decide on fallback policy tweak, assign owners for infra debt tasks.

Meeting logistics:
- Timebox: 45 minutes (start sharp).
- Attendees: eng-serving-runtime, infra, console-ux rep (see collaborators).
- Pre-reads: JIRA-2319 (model routing fallback), PR 1283 (KV cache warmup fix). Try to skim before joining.

Agenda (rough timings):
1) 5m — Quick wins / wins-to-celebrate (fast shoutouts)
2) 10m — Production health snapshot (latency / error hotspots)
   - Current 95p latency for gen endpoints: 180ms (up 12% week-over-week).
   - Recent spike window: 2026-03-09 02:30–03:10 UTC correlated with autoscaler thrash.
   - Console alert noise: duplicate alerts for pod OOMs in rp* clusters (see alert group id JIRA-2401).
3) 12m — Deployment and rollouts (Dedicated + hosted cadence)
   - Canary progress for runtime v1.12 (metrics looked ok but KV warmups slow in 10% traffic shard).
   - Decision: enable automatic fallback to quantized-variant when cache miss rate > 60%? Pro/con bullets prepared.
4) 10m — Console UX / tracing handoff
   - UX ask: expose token-level breakdown per request for top 5 routes. Rough design: add tracespan at tokenizer boundary.
   - Infra ask: can SRE expose a compact sampling of raw tokens for 1% sampled requests? privacy check needed.
5) 8m — Action review / owners / parking lot

Quick notes to self (bullet raw):
- Bring metric panel screenshot for 95p latency; compare region-us-west vs eu-west.
- Remind Leah about quota bump request for dedicated-beam test cluster.
- Ask Omar if autoscaler throttling experiment still running on staging (I think yes).
- Confirm who has rights to flip fallback policy in prod — probably infra-ops team.
- Bring up possibility: a short-term config toggle to reduce max-batch-size during peak to reduce tail latency.

Open questions (need clarity before next week):
- If we enable fallback to quantized variants, what's the expected QoL regression? Need a quick eval on 10 prompts (Leah drove a small eval but not finalized).
- How aggressive should cache warming be when we have many cold-starts from bursts? (proposal: small warmup shards that grab prefixes from prefix-store)
- Can we auto-tag user requests that hit fallback so CS can correlate complaints? (privacy check + opt-in)

Action items (assign and rough ETA) — live tracker (update status in meeting):
- ACTION-01: Add a short grafana panel comparing 95p latency by region and model-variant. Owner: Camille. ETA: 2026-03-13.
- ACTION-02: Leah to finalize 10-prompt eval for quantized fallback quality and share results in thread. Owner: Leah Park. ETA: 2026-03-15.
- ACTION-03: Ravi to triage autoscaler thrash logs and propose a temporary debounce (k8s HPA timing tweak). Owner: Ravi Nair. ETA: 2026-03-14.
- ACTION-04: Omar to check staging autoscaler experiment and confirm whether traffic shaping is live. Owner: Omar Suleiman. ETA: 2026-03-12.
- ACTION-05: Camille + Infra to draft a safe rollout plan for enabling fallback on 5% traffic. Owner: Camille Ortiz, Infra. ETA: 2026-03-16.
- ACTION-06: Console owner to spec token-level sampling data contract (privacy + storage TTL). Owner: Leah Park. ETA: 2026-03-18.
- ACTION-07 (parking): Investigate short-term batch-size throttle toggle for peak window; low priority spike mitigation. Owner: TBD. ETA: backlog.

Parking lot / follow-ups (not for this meeting unless time):
- Deep-dive on KV cache eviction policy (invite model infra).
- Plan for regional capacity test for eu-west next month.
- Post-mortem template for autoscaler thrash incidents — draft a template and circulate.

Meeting prep checklist for me (Camille):
- [ ] Export the 95p latency chart and place in the meeting doc.
- [ ] Slack ping to Leah/Ravi/Omar 1h before meeting to confirm attendance.
- [ ] Add the fallback pro/con bullets to the meeting slide deck.
- [ ] Prepare one-liner to summarize risk if we delay fallback decision.

Notes from previous sync (short):
- Last week we deferred the rollout because KV warmup patch caused 3% higher cold-start CPU.
- We agreed to instrument cache miss rate at request-level — work in PR 1283 is the first pass.

How to run the meeting (running doc style):
- Start: 60s quick wins.
- Health: show panel; call out anomalies.
- Rollouts: present binary decision (enable/hold) with recommended guard rails.
- UX: ask console owner for blockers and acceptance criteria.
- Close: run action list, confirm owners and ETAs, call out any blockers that need exec escalation.

Quick contact snippets to paste in Slack if needed:
- "Heads-up: going to propose fallback-on-5% at the weekly sync. Will share eval summary 3/15 — Camille"
- "Ravi/Omar: can you confirm autoscaler experiment status before standup? ping me if you need test creds."

End notes: keep this doc light; update action statuses inline after the meeting. If an action drags >2 weeks, mark as "stalled" and add reason.

----
Edit log: 2026-03-10 initial draft by Camille; 2026-03-12 updated actions after quick sync with Leah.
